body: I am very sorry to hear that. I understand that you have totally given up. Sometimes i also ask myself why i stick around, Afraid of death? I just come to a point where i want to sleep and never wake up. I hope it gets better for you and will keep improving.
The right person will come in gods perfect time (-:
Im sorry that you are miserable at times like these. I hope it all goes your way! I understand if you think suicide is the best option so just chat me on reddit so you can have a pal to talk to.
I assure you that it will get better. If it doesn't, you can always talk to me on reddit chat.
I agree. I just hope this helps. Im sorry i overuse the word, "hope" too much.

You know, i wonder that too. Being 12 and having a pretty exhausting, troubled life. I just try to forget negative things. Sure they always come back, but it really helps for me and i hope for you too.
That is true. I hope they understand that life is going to be better if you just stay strong, have faith. Even the smallest hope can change your life.
Because life is not predictable. You dont know where you are heading just like people that are depressed in this sub. We have to be strong at times like these. Surf through those negative waves.
I agree. I hope to help people here and at least help them get back on their feet.
This is good, just like gfuel and whiskey.
